name: Native NUN5 secondary font
description: Use NUN5's native 14x20 raster geometry and metrics for every same-semantic English glyph, reconstruct unsupported punctuation from clean NA2, preserve clean GF4C, apply the renderer's local horizontal factor to native leading bearings, and use the descriptor height only for the secondary glyph quad.
runtime_classification: Runtime-proven across matched Controls, Practice, Save/Load, and character-modal captures. The final guarded Controls run on worker ISO CRC 9B7C20AE read back the canonical helper and hook, restored the 24x28 secondary presentation, and retained the accepted width, spacing, bearing, and fit behavior; median height and center-Y deltas against NUN5 were both zero.
review_notes: Generated from hash-pinned clean NA2 and official NUN5 only. The user accepted the final font itself as almost pixel-for-pixel. Fullwidth Shift-JIS Save/Load digits remain on the primary 24-pixel path and are not a halfwidth-Latin parity target. The rejected m01, palette-swap, 10x22 resample, global-parser, and shared 28x28 approaches are not implementation parents.

description: During the animated post-battle score and currency calculation, Cross fast-forwards the tally to its final values. The later result-menu proceed handler remains separate.

name: Use one-part Ultimate Jutsu label
description: Make the OUGI label constructor instantiate one 128x64 regional label instead of two 64x64 Japanese halves.
review_notes: The NUN5 one-part behavior is semantically ported into NA2's different compiled loop; the exact replacement instruction does not occur in canonical NUN5 ELF, BTL, ETC, or ADV, so this remains an authored adaptation paired with the whole NUN5 OUGI.CCS import. The user reviewed the completed runtime pass and directed that screens absent from the remaining defect captures be treated as fixed; no OUGI defect remained.

name: Use localized Stage Select layout

The scale-word port redirects both preview-index consumers, keeps vertical name scale at 1.0, and loads only horizontal fit from the inline record. Two prompt constants copy exact NUN5 BTL instructions. After the integrated build, the user compared preserved Slot 3 against NUN5 and accepted Stage Select as fixed.

The Collection state renderer uses a separate nominal X=380/460 table at ETC offsets 0x2F010/0x2F018, while its NUN5 homolog adds the same -12/-8 regional offsets. Authored X=368/452 values in that dedicated NA2 table produce guarded slot-2 parity. The HOME action helper at NA2 FUN_006b44b0 is a different consumer: NUN5 homolog FUN_006c7250 applies state-specific regional geometry of -12 for Cross, localized-width-derived -24 for Play, and -8 for Triangle. A 16-byte tail-call wrapper in runtime-proven MWO3 header padding plus three guarded call redirects and the exact state-2 label compensation reproduce those effective anchors across every caller of this helper. NUN5's GP-relative language globals and rectangle accessors are ABI-incompatible with NA2, so these five rows are authored ports rather than literal donor code.
